projects.name: Migration from Legacy system to Open system Solutions
details: Worked extensively in the Payer Claims Tower domain for HMSA, handling critical components of healthcare claims processing.
Played a key role in implementing solutions using .NET, SQL Server, SSIS, and SSRS for improved scalability, performance, and reporting capabilities.
Key Responsibilities:
Migrated legacy IBM AS400 (iSeries) applications to a modern .NET MVC + SQL Server architecture, enhancing system flexibility and maintainability.
Developed .NET MVC-based applications to replace legacy green-screen systems, delivering user-friendly interfaces and seamless integration with SQL backend.
Developed and optimized SQL Server stored procedures, views, and queries to support high-performance data processing and application logic.
Designed and developed SSIS-based ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load large-scale AS400 (DB2) data into SQL Server with high accuracy.
Designed and delivered SSRS reports and dashboards, enabling business users to access real-time insights and replacing static AS400 reporting.
Automated workflows using Tidal Scheduler, orchestrating SSIS packages, SQL jobs, and reporting processes to ensure end-to-end data pipeline automation.
Well versed with Azure Dev ops and Service Now.
Exp working in Creating SSIS package and configuring it for SIT/UAT testing.
Exp working on hosting webapps/Windows/Console Apps thru IIS Server.
Built a WPF desktop tool for claims processing that allows loading EDI files, validating data, and inserting records into the database.
Good Team handling capacity and able to resolve the Issues quickly and effectively.
Participating effectively in all the Projects meeting and providing valuable inputs.
Good Experience in driving Scrum and Planning call with effective steps to achieve sprint Goal.
Technical Environment | Visual Studio 2017/2019/2022, SQL server 2016/2019, SSIS, SSRS, Service Now ticketing tool (SNOW), .net MVC, Windows/Web Apps, Tidal Job Scheduler/HIPPA
Molina Healthcare Medicaid and Medicaid- Payer
